BTC.note: Binance hack: an exchange breach, not Bitcoin itself
BTC.detail: Binance (an exchange) lost about US$6.3-6.4bn on 29-30 Oct via a compromised staff laptop, not a flaw in Bitcoin. Binance says no private keys leaked and it will cover all losses; about US$3bn has been frozen. The attacker's 18,270 BTC sit in 19 wallets and have not moved. Withdrawals are due back around Sun 1 Nov; proof-of-reserves results are due Mon 2 Nov. Watch for: the attacker selling BTC, or a reserves shortfall. No Bitcoin protocol or wallet bugs with funds at risk, and no new quantum threat (latest estimates are theoretical; hardware expected early 2030s).

TSLA.detail: No confirmed Tesla breach. A Sept 2026 hacking-forum claim is unverified and Tesla has made no statement; the June 2026 Tata Electronics breach was a supplier, not Tesla.

MSTR.detail: Strategy itself was not hacked. The Binance hack only moved its share price through Bitcoin.

SEMI.detail: No breaches at SEMI's top holdings. NVIDIA's July 2026 DCGM software bug (CVE-2026-47483) was patched.
